scope: Read-only audit and minimum executable source plan for a fair K1/K8/K1x8 PT, mapped-gate SAIF, and PTPX campaign. M974 authorizes no EDA execution.

m872_canonical.flow: Synopsys DC, TSMC 28 nm standard-cell logic only, 3.000 ns ideal clock, ZeroWireload, zero macros

reason_existing_activity_not_reusable: Neither the sealed M859 VCS result nor sealed M872 DC result contains SAIF, VCD, or FSDB activity.
The surviving M859 simv/csrc tree is outside the canonical sealed result, contains no captured activity, and co-instantiates only K8 and K1x8 RTL rather than the three exact M872 mapped netlists.
RTL activity remapping would not prove exact mapped-net annotation and cannot substitute for direct mapped-gate activity.

minimum_missing_files.requirements: Instantiate the unchanged M872 top through one DUT scope; compile separately against each exact K1/K8/K1x8 mapped netlist; reuse the deterministic eight-bank memory protocol; run the same five M867 payload cases; verify numeric outputs and request/response multisets.

Capture only the mapped DUT, exclude reset and testbench/memory-model logic, emit one SAIF per workload per axis, and bind start/end to header_accept and token_done_accept rather than wall-clock guesses.
Read each exact mapped netlist and SDC, loop across five SAIFs, enforce annotation/check_power gates before update_power, and emit setup, activity, power, hierarchy and per-clock reports.

minimum_missing_files.file: one fail-closed sequential runner plus source contract/release
minimum_missing_files.requirements: Pin all upstream seals, tools, standard-cell models/libraries and new sources; run K1, K8, K1x8 in one attempt; prohibit cross-attempt or partial-axis publication; seal negative/incomplete outcomes.

phase_1_mapped_gate_activity.runs: three mapped-gate VCS simulations, one per axis; each simulation emits five per-case SAIFs
phase_1_mapped_gate_activity.memory_service: same eight independent banks, same latency/ready policy and same weights for every axis
phase_1_mapped_gate_activity.measurement_window: per case, from accepted header through accepted token_done; reset and inter-case idle excluded

required_correctness.k1_cycles: new diagnostic ledger; never an equal-bandwidth headline denominator

phase_1_mapped_gate_activity.simulation_scope: mapped-gate zero-delay prelayout activity; no SDF and no glitch-accurate claim

phase_2_pt_annotation_and_sta.hold: fast-corner prelayout diagnostic only; not signoff without extracted parasitics/CTS

annotation_gate.nonzero_toggle_percent: report, do not impose a 95% floor because real sparsity is the measured phenomenon

phase_3_ptpx.aggregate_formula: sum energy across the same five cases; never average unweighted power across unequal durations

decision_gates_after_execution.admit_logic_power_number: all correctness, identity, annotation, PT and check_power gates pass for all three axes and all five cases
decision_gates_after_execution.main_energy_efficiency_support: aggregate K1x8/K8 standard-cell logic energy ratio >= 2.0x, no nonzero case worse than 0.95x, and ratio change across 50/100/200 ps slew <= 10%
decision_gates_after_execution.supporting_energy_only: aggregate ratio >= 1.10x but < 2.0x, with no unexplained case reversal
decision_gates_after_execution.no_go_energy_advantage: aggregate ratio < 1.10x, any identity/annotation/TX/check_power failure, or mismatch in frozen equal-bandwidth work
always_report: logic energy per case and aggregate

minimum_for_macro_inclusive_energy: exact SRAM bank capacity/count/ports and matching foundry macro .db or independently sealed per-access energy
read/write/address activity and access counts for each bank under the same workload
macro PVT aligned with the standard-cell power corner
minimum_for_system_energy: sealed ordered H67 FC2 raw4/header/end stream rather than five directed cases
full-network operator schedule and SRAM/DRAM transactions
clock-tree/interconnect or explicitly labeled prelayout sensitivity
all non-C2 operator and memory energy
forbidden_claims: energy per frame from five directed cases
K8 versus single K1 energy headline

p1_findings: No sealed mapped-gate SAIF/VCD/FSDB currently exists, so power and energy remain false.
No ordered 120-record H67 FC2 transaction stream currently exists for direct M803/K1x8 replay; the five-case campaign is component-directed only.
The M872 top exposes external memory pins and contains zero SRAM macros, so a future PTPX result excludes weight-memory, clock-tree, extracted-wire and system energy.
p2_findings: The unsealed M859 work directory contains compiled RTL simv artifacts but is not reusable paper evidence and must not be imported into the new identity.
A zero-delay mapped-gate SAIF is sufficient for a labeled prelayout comparison, but not glitch-accurate; SDF and extracted-parasitic sensitivity remain later strengthening steps.
